verses.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with YAHUAH, and the Word was YAHUAH.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ቃል ነበረ፥ ቃልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ፥ ቃልም እግዚአብሔር ነበረ።
verses.gez: በቀዳሚ ግብር ቃል ውእቱ ወቃል ኀበ እግዚአብሔር ውእቱ ወእግዚአብሔር ውእቱ ቃል።

verses.en: The same was in the beginning with YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህ በመጀመሪያው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.am: ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ከሆነውም አንዳች ስንኳ ያለ እርሱ አልሆነም።

verses.en: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.am: በእርሱ ሕይወት ነበረች፥ ሕይወትም የሰው ብርሃን ነበረች።

verses.en: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.am: ብርሃንም በጨለማ ይበራል፥ ጨለማም አላሸነፈውም።
verses.gez: ወብርሃን ውስተ ጽልመት የበርህ፤ ወጽልመትኒ ኢኀረዮ።

verses.en: There was a man sent from YAHUAH, whose name was Yohanan.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የተላከ ስሙ ዮሐንስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.am: ሁሉ በእርሱ በኩል እንዲያምኑ ይህ ስለ ብርሃን ይመሰክር ዘንድ ለምስክር መጣ።

verses.en: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.am: ስለ ብርሃን ሊመሰክር መጣ እንጂ፥ እርሱ ብርሃን አልነበረም።

verses.en: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.am: ለሰው ሁሉ የሚያበራው እውነተኛው ብርሃን ወደ ዓለም ይመጣ ነበር።

verses.en: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.am: በዓለም ነበረ፥ ዓለሙም በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ዓለሙም አላወቀውም።

verses.en: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.am: የእርሱ ወደ ሆነው መጣ፥ የገዛ ወገኖቹም አልተቀበሉትም።

verses.en: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of YAHUAH, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.am: ለተቀበሉት ሁሉ ግን፥ በስሙ ለሚያምኑት ለእነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ ሥልጣንን ሰጣቸው፤

verses.en: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከእግዚአብሔር ተወለዱ እንጂ ከደም ወይም ከሥጋ ፈቃድ ወይም ከወንድ ፈቃድ አልተወለዱም።

verses.en: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.am: ቃልም ሥጋ ሆነ፤ ጸጋንና እውነትንም ተመልቶ በእኛ አደረ፥ አንድ ልጅም ከአባቱ ዘንድ እንዳለው ክብር የሆነው ክብሩን አየን።
verses.gez: ወቃል ሥጋ ኮነ ወኀደረ ኀቤነ፤ ወርኢነ ስብሓቲሁ ስብሓተ ኀበ አብ ዋሕድ ምሉአ ጸጋ ወጽድቅ።

verses.en: Yohanan bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ ስለ እርሱ መሰከረ እንዲህም ብሎ ጮኸ። ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው እርሱ ከእኔ በፊት ነበረና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል፤ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.am: እኛ ሁላችን ከሙላቱ ተቀብለን በጸጋ ላይ ጸጋ ተሰጥቶናልና ሕግ በሙሴ ተሰጥቶ ነበርና፤

verses.en: For the law was given by Mosheh, but grace and truth came by Yahushua the Messiah.
verses.am: ጸጋና እውነት ግን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ሆነ።

verses.en: No man hath seen YAHUAH at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.am: መቼም ቢሆን እግዚአብሔርን ያየው አንድ ስንኳ የለም፤ በአባቱ እቅፍ ያለ አንድ ልጁ እርሱ ተረከው።

verses.en: And this is the record of Yohanan, when the Yehudim sent priests and Levites from Yerushalayim to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.am: አይሁድም። አንተ ማን ነህ? ብለው ይጠይቁት ዘንድ ከኢየሩሳሌም ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንን በላኩበት ጊዜ፥ የዮሐንስ ምስክርነት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Messiah.
verses.am: መሰከረም አልካደምም፤ እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም ብሎ መሰከረ።

verses.en: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.am: እንኪያስ ማን ነህ? ኤልያስ ነህን? ብለው ጠየቁት። አይደለሁም አለ። ነቢዩ ነህን? አይደለሁም ብሎ መለሰ።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.am: እንኪያስ። ማን ነህ? ለላኩን መልስ እንድንሰጥ፤ ስለራስህ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Master, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.am: እርሱም። ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ እንዳለ። የጌታን መንገድ አቅኑ ብሎ በምድረ በዳ የሚጮኽ ሰው ድምፅ እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Messiah, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.am: የተላኩትም ከፈሪሳውያን ነበሩና። እንኪያስ አንተ ክርስቶስ ወይም ኤልያስ ወይም ነቢዩ ካይደለህ፥ ስለ ምን ታጠምቃለህ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: Yohanan answered them, saying, I immerse with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መልሶ። እኔ በውኃ አጠምቃለሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት በመካከላችሁ ቆሞአል፤

verses.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.am: እኔ የጫማውን ጠፍር ልፈታ የማይገባኝ፥ ከእኔ በኋላ የሚመጣው ከእኔ ይልቅ የሚከብር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where Yohanan was baptizing.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር ዮሐንስ ያጠምቅበት በነበረው በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በቢታንያ በቤተ ራባ ሆነ።

verses.en: The next day Yohanan seeth Yahushua coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of YAHUAH, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.am: በነገው ዮሐንስ ኢየሱስን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ እንዲህ አለ። እነሆ የዓለምን ኃጢአት የሚያስወግድ የእግዚአብሔር በግ።

verses.en: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.am: አንድ ሰው ከእኔ በኋላ ይመጣል፥ ከእኔም በፊት ነበርና ከእኔ ይልቅ የከበረ ሆኖአል ብዬ ስለ እርሱ ያልሁት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Yisra'el, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.am: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን ለእስራኤል ይገለጥ ዘንድ ስለዚህ በውኃ እያጠመቅሁ እኔ መጣሁ።

verses.en: And Yohanan bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም እንዲህ ብሎ መሰከረ። መንፈስ ከሰማይ እንደ ርግብ ሆኖ ሲወርድ አየሁ፤ በእርሱ ላይም ኖረ።

verses.en: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to immerse with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Set-apart Spirit.
verses.am: እኔም አላውቀውም ነበር፥ ዳሩ ግን በውኃ አጠምቅ ዘንድ የላከኝ እርሱ። መንፈስ ሲወርድበትና ሲኖርበት የምታየው፥ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የሚያጠምቅ እርሱ ነው አለኝ።

verses.en: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኔም አይቻለሁ እርሱም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ መስክሬአለሁ።

verses.en: Again the next day after Yohanan stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.am: በነገው ደግሞ ዮሐንስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ሁለት ቆመው ነበር፥

verses.en: And looking upon Yahushua as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of YAHUAH!
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ሲሄድ ተመልክቶ። እነሆ የእግዚአብሔር በግ አለ።

verses.en: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Yahushua.
verses.am: ሁለቱም ደቀ መዛሙርት ሲናገር ሰምተው ኢየሱስን ተከተሉት።

verses.en: Then Yahushua turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዘወር ብሎ ሲከተሉትም አይቶ። ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ? አላቸው።

verses.en: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.am: እነርሱም። ረቢ፥ ወዴት ትኖራለህ? አሉት፤ ትርጓሜው መምህር ሆይ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: One of the two which heard Yohanan speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Kepha's brother.
verses.am: መጥታችሁ እዩ አላቸው። መጥተው የሚኖርበትን አዩ፥ በዚያም ቀን በእርሱ ዘንድ ዋሉ፤ አሥር ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Messiah.
verses.am: ከዮሐንስ ዘንድ ሰምተው ከተከተሉት ከሁለቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought him to Yahushua. And when Yahushua beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.am: እርሱ አስቀድሞ የራሱን ወንድም ስምዖንን አገኘውና። መሢሕን አግኝተናል አለው፤ ትርጓሜውም ክርስቶስ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: The day following Yahushua would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.am: ወደ ኢየሱስም አመጣው። ኢየሱስም ተመልክቶ። አንተ የዮና ልጅ ስምዖን ነህ፤ አንተ ኬፋ ትባላለህ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው ጴጥሮስ ማለት ነው።

verses.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Kepha.
verses.am: በነገው ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ሊወጣ ወደደ፥ ፊልጶስንም አገኘና። ተከተለኝ አለው።

verses.en: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Mosheh in the law, and the prophets, did write, Yahushua of Nazareth, the son of Yoseph.
verses.am: ፊልጶስም ከእንድርያስና ከጴጥሮስ ከተማ ከቤተ ሳይዳ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ ናትናኤልን አግኝቶ። ሙሴ በሕግ ነቢያትም ስለ እርሱ የጻፉትን የዮሴፍን ልጅ የናዝሬቱን ኢየሱስን አግኝተነዋል አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Yisra'elite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.am: ናትናኤልም። ከናዝሬት መልካም ነገር ሊወጣ ይችላልን? አለው። ፊልጶስ። መጥተህ እይ አለው።

verses.en: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Yahushua answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ናትናኤልን ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አይቶ ስለ እርሱ። ተንኰል የሌለበት በእውነት የእስራኤል ሰው እነሆ አለ።

verses.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of YAHUAH; thou art the King of Yisra'el.
verses.am: ናትናኤልም። ከወዴት ታውቀኛለህ? አለው። ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ፊልጶስ ሳይጠራህ፥ ከበለስ በታች ሳለህ፥ አየሁህ አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.am: ናትናኤልም መልሶ። መምህር ሆይ፥ አንተ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ነህ፤ አንተ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ነህ አለው።

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of YAHUAH ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከበለስ በታች አየሁህ ስላልሁህ አመንህን? ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ነገር ታያለህ አለው።

verses.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Yahushua was there:
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን በገሊላ ቃና ሰርግ ነበረ፥ የኢየሱስም እናት በዚያ ነበረች፤

verses.en: And both Yahushua was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ወደ ሰርጉ ታደሙ።

verses.en: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Yahushua saith unto him, They have no wine.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅም ባለቀ ጊዜ የኢየሱስ እናት። የወይን ጠጅ እኮ የላቸውም አለችው።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። አንቺ ሴት፥ ከአንቺ ጋር ምን አለኝ? ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም አላት።

verses.en: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
verses.am: እናቱም ለአገልጋዮቹ። የሚላችሁን ሁሉ አድርጉ አለቻቸው።

verses.en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Yehudim, containing two or three firkins apiece.
verses.am: አይሁድም እንደሚያደርጉት የማንጻት ልማድ ስድስት የድንጋይ ጋኖች በዚያ ተቀምጠው ነበር፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም ሁለት ወይም ሦስት እንስራ ይይዙ ነበር።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ጋኖቹን ውኃ ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሙሉአቸው አላቸው። እስከ አፋቸውም ሞሉአቸው።

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
verses.am: አሁን ቀድታችሁ ለአሳዳሪው ስጡት አላቸው፤ ሰጡትም።

verses.en: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
verses.am: አሳዳሪውም የወይን ጠጅ የሆነውን ውሃ በቀመሰ ጊዜ ከወዴት እንደ መጣ አላወቀም፤ ውኃውን የቀዱት አገልጋዮች ግን ያውቁ ነበር፤ አሳዳሪው ሙሽራውን ጠርቶ።

verses.en: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
verses.am: ሰው ሁሉ አስቀድሞ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ ያቀርባል፥ ከሰከሩም በኋላ መናኛውን፤ አንተስ መልካሙን የወይን ጠጅ እስከ አሁን አቆይተሃል አለው።

verses.en: This beginning of miracles did Yahushua in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን የምልክቶች መጀመሪያ በገሊላ ቃና አደረገ፤ ክብሩንም ገለጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ከእናቱና ከወንድሞቹ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ጋር ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ወረደ፥ በዚያም ጥቂት ቀን ኖሩ።

verses.en: And the Yehudim' passover was at hand, and Yahushua went up to Yerushalayim,
verses.am: የአይሁድ ፋሲካም ቀርቦ ነበር፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
verses.am: በመቅደስም በሬዎችንና በጎችን ርግቦችንም የሚሸጡትን ገንዘብ ለዋጮችንም ተቀምጠው አገኘ፤

verses.en: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
verses.am: የገመድም ጅራፍ አበጅቶ ሁሉን በጎችንም በሬዎችንም ከመቅደስ አወጣቸው፥ የለዋጮችንም ገንዘብ አፈሰሰ ገበታዎቻቸውንም ገለበጠ፥

verses.en: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
verses.am: ርግብ ሻጪዎችንም። ይህን ከዚህ ውሰዱ፤ የአባቴን ቤት የንግድ ቤት አታድርጉት አላቸው።

verses.en: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። የቤትህ ቅናት ይበላኛል ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አሰቡ።

verses.en: Then answered the Yehudim and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ መልሰው። ይህን ስለምታደርግ ምን ምልክት ታሳየናለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ይህን ቤተ መቅደስ አፍርሱት፥ በሦስት ቀንም አነሣዋለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said the Yehudim, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
verses.am: ስለዚህ አይሁድ። ይህ ቤተ መቅደስ ከአርባ ስድስት ዓመት ጀምሮ ይሠራ ነበር፥ አንተስ በሦስት ቀን ታነሣዋለህን? አሉት።

verses.en: But he spake of the temple of his body.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ ሰውነቱ ቤተ መቅደስ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Yahushua had said.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሙታን ከተነሣ በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ይህን እንደ ተናገረ አሰቡና መጽሐፍንና ኢየሱስ የተናገረውን ቃል አመኑ።

verses.en: Now when he was in Yerushalayim at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
verses.am: በፋሲካ በዓልም በኢየሩሳሌም ሳለ፥ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ ብዙ ሰዎች በስሙ አመኑ፤

verses.en: But Yahushua did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Yehudim:
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም ወገን የአይሁድ አለቃ የሆነ ኒቆዲሞስ የሚባል አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ እርሱም በሌሊት ወደ ኢየሱስ መጥቶ።

verses.en: The same came to Yahushua by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from YAHUAH: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except YAHUAH be with him.
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ከሆነ በቀር አንተ የምታደርጋቸውን እነዚህን ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ የሚችል የለምና መምህር ሆነህ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ እንደ መጣህ እናውቃለን አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ዳግመኛ ካልተወለደ በቀር የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ሊያይ አይችልም አለው።

verses.en: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
verses.am: ኒቆዲሞስም። ሰው ከሸመገለ በኋላ እንዴት ሊወለድ ይችላል? ሁለተኛ ወደ እናቱ ማኅፀን ገብቶ ይወለድ ዘንድ ይችላልን? አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ ሰው ከውኃና ከመንፈስ ካልተወለደ በቀር ወደ እግዚአብሔር መንግሥት ሊገባ አይችልም።

verses.en: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.am: ከሥጋ የተወለደ ሥጋ ነው፥ ከመንፈስም የተወለደ መንፈስ ነው።

verses.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
verses.am: ዳግመኛ ልትወለዱ ያስፈልጋችኋል ስላልሁህ አታድንቅ።

verses.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
verses.am: ነፋስ ወደሚወደው ይነፍሳል፥ ድምፁንም ትሰማለህ፥ ነገር ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣ ወዴትም እንዲሄድ አታውቅም፤ ከመንፈስ የተወለደ ሁሉ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
verses.am: ኒቆዲሞስ መልሶ። ይህ እንዴት ሊሆን ይችላል? አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Yisra'el, and knowest not these things?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ እንዲህ አለው። አንተ የእስራኤል መምህር ስትሆን ይህን አታውቅምን?

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እልሃለሁ፥ የምናውቀውን እንናገራለን ያየነውንም እንመሰክራለን፥ ምስክራችንንም አትቀበሉትም።

verses.en: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
verses.am: ስለ ምድራዊ ነገር በነገርኋችሁ ጊዜ ካላመናችሁ፥ ስለ ሰማያዊ ነገር ብነግራችሁ እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.en: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
verses.am: ከሰማይም ከወረደ በቀር ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ ማንም የለም፥ እርሱም በሰማይ የሚኖረው የሰው ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: And as Mosheh lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።

verses.en: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዲኖረው እንጂ እንዳይጠፋ እግዚአብሔር አንድያ ልጁን እስኪሰጥ ድረስ ዓለሙን እንዲሁ ወዶአልና።

verses.en: For YAHUAH so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
verses.am: ዓለም በልጁ እንዲድን ነው እንጂ፥ በዓለም እንዲፈርድ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ዓለም አልላከውምና።
verses.gez: እስመ ከመዝ አፍቀሮ እግዚአብሔር ለዓለም እስከ ወሀበ ወልዶ ዋሕደ፤ ከመ ኵሉ ዘየአምን ቦቱ ኢይትሐጐል አላ ይረክብ ሕይወተ ዘለዓለም።

verses.en: For YAHUAH sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
verses.am: በእርሱ በሚያምን አይፈረድበትም፤ በማያምን ግን በአንዱ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ስም ስላላመነ አሁን ተፈርዶበታል።

verses.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ብርሃንም ወደ ዓለም ስለ መጣ ሰዎችም ሥራቸው ክፉ ነበርና ከብርሃን ይልቅ ጨለማን ስለ ወደዱ ፍርዱ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.am: ክፉ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ብርሃንን ይጠላልና፥ ሥራውም እንዳይገለጥ ወደ ብርሃን አይመጣም፤

verses.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
verses.am: እውነትን የሚያደርግ ግን ሥራው በእግዚአብሔር ተደርጎ እንደ ሆነ ይገለጥ ዘንድ ወደ ብርሃን ይመጣል።

verses.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ይሁዳ አገር መጣ፥ በዚያም ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቀምጦ ያጠምቅ ነበር።

verses.en: After these things came Yahushua and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and immersed.
verses.am: ዮሐንስም ደግሞ በሳሌም አቅራቢያ በሄኖን በዚያ ብዙ ውኃ ነበርና ያጠምቅ ነበር፥

verses.en: And Yohanan also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were immersed.
verses.am: እየመጡም ይጠመቁ ነበር ዮሐንስ ገና ወደ ወኅኒ አልተጨመረም ነበርና።

verses.en: For Yohanan was not yet cast into prison.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በዮሐንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና በአይሁድ መካከል ስለ ማንጻት ክርክር ሆነ።

verses.en: Then there arose a question between some of Yohanan's disciples and the Yehudim about purifying.
verses.am: ወደ ዮሐንስም መጥተው። መምህር ሆይ፥ በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ከአንተ ጋር የነበረው አንተም የመሰከርህለት፥ እነሆ፥ እርሱ ያጠምቃል ሁሉም ወደ እርሱ ይመጣሉ አሉት።

verses.en: And they came unto Yohanan, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
verses.am: ዮሐንስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። ከሰማይ ካልተሰጠው ሰው እንዳች ሊቀበል አይችልም።

verses.en: Yohanan answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
verses.am: እናንተ። እኔ ክርስቶስ አይደለሁም፥ ነገር ግን። ከእርሱ በፊት ተልኬአለሁ እንዳልሁ ራሳችሁ ትመሰክሩልኛላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Messiah, but that I am sent before him.
verses.am: ሙሽራይቱ ያለችው እርሱ ሙሽራ ነው፤ ቆሞ የሚሰማው ሚዜው ግን በሙሽራው ድምጽ እጅግ ደስ ይለዋል። እንግዲህ ይህ ደስታዬ ተፈጸመ።

verses.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
verses.am: እርሱ ሊልቅ እኔ ግን ላንስ ያስፈልጋል።

verses.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
verses.am: ከላይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው፤ ከምድር የሚሆነው የምድር ነው የምድሩንም ይናገራል። ከሰማይ የሚመጣው ከሁሉ በላይ ነው።

verses.en: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
verses.am: ያየውንና የሰማውንም ይህን ይመሰክራል፥ ምስክሩንም የሚቀበለው የለም።

verses.en: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
verses.am: ምስክሩን የተቀበለ እግዚአብሔር እውነተኛ እንደ ሆነ አተመ።

verses.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that YAHUAH is true.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የላከው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይናገራልና፤ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን ሰፍሮ አይሰጥምና።

verses.en: For he whom YAHUAH hath sent speaketh the words of YAHUAH: for YAHUAH giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
verses.am: አባት ልጁን ይወዳል ሁሉንም በእጁ ሰጥቶታል።

verses.en: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
verses.am: በልጁ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፤ በልጁ የማያምን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በእርሱ ላይ ይኖራል እንጂ ሕይወትን አያይም።

verses.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of YAHUAH abideth on him.
When therefore the Master knew how the Pharisees had heard that Yahushua made and immersed more disciples than Yohanan,
verses.am: እንግዲህ። ኢየሱስ ከዮሐንስ ይልቅ ደቀ መዛሙርት ያደርጋል ያጠምቅማል ማለትን ፈሪሳውያን እንደ ሰሙ ጌታ ባወቀ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: (Though Yahushua himself immersed not, but his disciples,)
He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.am: ይሁዳን ትቶ ወደ ገሊላ ደግሞ ሄደ፤ ዳሩ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ራሱ አላጠመቀም።

verses.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.am: በሰማርያም ሊያልፍ ግድ ሆነበት።

verses.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Ya'aqob gave to his son Yoseph.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያዕቆብ ለልጁ ለዮሴፍ በሰጠው ስፍራ አጠገብ ወደምትሆን ሲካር ወደምትባል የሰማርያ ከተማ መጣ፤

verses.en: Now Ya'aqob's well was there. Yahushua therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.am: በዚያም የያዕቆብ ጕድጓድ ነበረ። ኢየሱስም መንገድ ከመሄድ ደክሞ በጕድጓድ አጠገብ እንዲህ ተቀመጠ፤ ጊዜውም ስድስት ሰዓት ያህል ነበረ።

verses.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Yahushua saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.am: ከሰማርያ አንዲት ሴት ውኃ ልትቀዳ መጣች። ኢየሱስም። ውኃ አጠጪኝ አላት፤

verses.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ምግብ ሊገዙ ወደ ከተማ ሄደው ነበርና።

verses.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Yehudi, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Yehudim have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሳምራዊቲቱ። አንተ የይሁዳ ሰው ስትሆን ሳምራዊት ሴት ከምሆን ከእኔ መጠጥ እንዴት ትለምናለህ? አለችው፤ አይሁድ ከሳምራውያን ጋር አይተባበሩም ነበርና።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of YAHUAH, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። የእግዚአብሔርን ስጦታና። ውኃ አጠጪኝ የሚልሽ ማን መሆኑንስ ብታውቂ፥ አንቺ ትለምኚው ነበርሽ የሕይወትም ውኃ ይሰጥሽ ነበር አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ መቅጃ የለህም ጕድጓዱም ጥልቅ ነው፤ እንግዲህ የሕይወት ውኃ ከወዴት ታገኛለህ?

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Ya'aqob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.am: በእውኑ አንተ ይህን ጕድጓድ ከሰጠን ከአባታችን ከያዕቆብ ትበልጣለህን? ራሱም ልጆቹም ከብቶቹም ከዚህ ጠጥተዋል አለችው።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። ከዚህ ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ እንደ ገና ይጠማል፤

verses.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.am: እኔ ከምሰጠው ውኃ የሚጠጣ ሁሉ ግን ለዘላለም አይጠማም፥ እኔ የምሰጠው ውኃ በእርሱ ውስጥ ለዘላለም ሕይወት የሚፈልቅ የውኃ ምንጭ ይሆናል እንጂ አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ እንዳልጠማ ውኃም ልቀዳ ወደዚህ እንዳልመጣ ይህን ውኃ ስጠኝ አለችው።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሂጂና ባልሽን ጠርተሽ ወደዚህ ነዪ አላት።

verses.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Yahushua said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.am: ሴቲቱ መልሳ። ባል የለኝም አለችው። ኢየሱስ። ባል የለኝም በማለትሽ መልካም ተናገርሽ፤

verses.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.am: አምስት ባሎች ነበሩሽና፥ አሁን ከአንቺ ጋር ያለው ባልሽ አይደለም፤ በዚህስ እውነት ተናገርሽ አላት።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ነቢይ እንደ ሆንህ አያለሁ።

verses.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Yerushalayim is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን በዚህ ተራራ ሰገዱ፤ እናንተም። ሰው ሊሰግድበት የሚገባው ስፍራ በኢየሩሳሌም ነው ትላላችሁ አለችው።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Yerushalayim, worship the Father.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላት። አንቺ ሴት፥ እመኚኝ፥ በዚህ ተራራ ወይም በኢየሩሳሌም ለአብ የማትሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Yehudim.
verses.am: እናንተስ ለማታውቁት ትሰግዳላችሁ፤ እኛ መዳን ከአይሁድ ነውና ለምናውቀው እንሰግዳለን።

verses.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእውነት የሚሰግዱ ለአብ በመንፈስና በእውነት የሚሰግዱበት ጊዜ ይመጣል አሁንም ሆኖአል፤ አብ ሊሰግዱለት እንደ እነዚህ ያሉትን ይሻልና፤

verses.en: YAHUAH is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ነው፥ የሚሰግዱለትም በመንፈስና በእውነት ሊሰግዱለት ያስፈልጋቸዋል።

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Messiah: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.am: ሴቲቱ። ክርስቶስ የሚባል መሲሕ እንዲመጣ አውቃለሁ፤ እርሱ ሲመጣ ሁሉን ይነግረናል አለችው።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። የምናገርሽ እኔ እርሱ ነኝ አላት።

verses.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ መጡና ከሴት ጋር በመነጋገሩ ተደነቁ፤ ነገር ግን። ምን ትፈልጊያለሽ? ወይም። ስለ ምን ትናገራታለህ? ያለ ማንም አልነበረም።

verses.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.am: ሴቲቱም እንስራዋን ትታ ወደ ከተማ ሄደች ለሰዎችም።

verses.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Messiah?
verses.am: ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ የነገረኝን ሰው ኑና እዩ፤ እንጃ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ይሆንን? አለች።

verses.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.am: ከከተማ ወጥተው ወደ እርሱ ይመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.am: ይህም ሲሆን ሳለ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። መምህር ሆይ፥ ብላ ብለው ለመኑት።

verses.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እናንተ የማታውቁት የምበላው መብል ለእኔ አለኝ አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ። የሚበላው አንዳች ሰው አምጥቶለት ይሆንን? ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የእኔስ መብል የላከኝን ፈቃድ አደርግ ዘንድ ሥራውንም እፈጽም ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.am: እናንተ። ገና አራት ወር ቀርቶአል መከርም ይመጣል ትሉ የለምን? እነሆ እላችኋለሁ፥ ዓይናችሁን አንሡ አዝመራውም አሁን እንደ ነጣ እርሻውን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.am: የሚያጭድ ደመወዝን ይቀበላል፥ የሚዘራና የሚያጭድም አብረው ደስ እንዲላቸው ለዘላለም ሕይወት ፍሬን ይሰበስባል።

verses.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.am: አንዱ ይዘራል አንዱም ያጭዳል የሚለው ቃል በዚህ እውነት ሆኖአልና።

verses.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.am: እኔም እናንተ ያልደከማችሁበትን ታጭዱ ዘንድ ሰደድኋችሁ፤ ሌሎች ደከሙ እናንተም በድካማቸው ገባችሁ።

verses.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.am: ሴቲቱም። ያደረግሁትን ሁሉ ነገረኝ ብላ ስለ መሰከረችው ቃል ከዚያች ከተማ የሰማርያ ሰዎች ብዙ አመኑበት።

verses.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.am: የሰማርያ ሰዎችም ወደ እርሱ በመጡ ጊዜ በእነርሱ ዘንድ እንዲኖር ለመኑት፤ በዚያም ሁለት ቀን ያህል ኖረ።

verses.en: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.am: ስለ ቃሉ ከፊተኞች ይልቅ ብዙ ሰዎች አመኑ፤

verses.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Messiah, the Saviour of the world.
verses.am: ሴቲቱንም። አሁን የምናምን ስለ ቃልሽ አይደለም፥ እኛ ራሳችን ሰምተነዋልና፤ እርሱም በእውነት ክርስቶስ የዓለም መድኃኒት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን ይሉአት ነበር።

verses.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.am: ከሁለቱ ቀኖችም በኋላ ከዚያ ወጥቶ ወደ ገሊላ ሄደ።

verses.en: For Yahushua himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.am: ነቢይ በገዛ አገሩ እንዳይከበር ኢየሱስ ራሱ መስክሮአልና።

verses.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Yerushalayim at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.am: ወደ ገሊላም በመጣ ጊዜ፥ የገሊላ ሰዎች ራሳቸው ደግሞ ለበዓል መጥተው ነበርና በበዓል በኢየሩሳሌም ያደረገውን ሁሉ ስላዩ ተቀበሉት።

verses.en: So Yahushua came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ውኃውን የወይን ጠጅ ወዳደረገባት ወደ ገሊላ ቃና ዳግመኛ መጣ። በቅፍርናሆምም ልጁ የታመመበት ከንጉሥ ቤት አንድ ሹም ነበረ።

verses.en: When he heard that Yahushua was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.am: እርሱም ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ እንደ መጣ ሰምቶ ልጁ ሊሞት ስላለው ወደ እርሱ ሄደ ወርዶም እንዲፈውስለት ለመነው።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። ምልክትና ድንቅ ነገር ካላያችሁ ከቶ አታምኑም አለው።

verses.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.am: ሹሙም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ብላቴናዬ ሳይሞት ውረድ አለው።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Yahushua had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሂድ፤ ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ አለው። ሰውዬውም ኢየሱስ የነገረውን ቃል አምኖ ሄደ።

verses.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.am: እርሱም ሲወርድ ሳለ ባሮቹ ተገናኙትና። ብላቴናህ በሕይወት አለ ብለው ነገሩት።

verses.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.am: እርሱም በጎ የሆነበትን ሰዓት ጠየቃቸው፤ እነርሱም። ትናንት በሰባት ሰዓት ንዳዱ ለቀቀው አሉት።

verses.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Yahushua said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.am: አባቱም ኢየሱስ። ልጅህ በሕይወት አለ ባለው በዚያ ሰዓት እንደ ሆነ አወቀ፤ እርሱም ከቤተ ሰዎቹ ሁሉ ጋር አመነ።

verses.en: This is again the second miracle that Yahushua did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.am: ይህም ደግሞ ኢየሱስ ከይሁዳ ወደ ገሊላ መጥቶ ያደረገው ሁለተኛ ምልክት ነው።

verses.en: After this there was a feast of the Yehudim; and Yahushua went up to Yerushalayim.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ የአይሁድ በዓል ነበረ፥ ኢየሱስም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወጣ።

verses.en: Now there is at Yerushalayim by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Ibri tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
verses.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም በበጎች በር አጠገብ በዕብራይስጥ ቤተ ሳይዳ የምትባል አንዲት መጠመቂያ ነበረች፤ አምስትም መመላለሻ ነበረባት።

verses.en: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
verses.am: በእነዚህ ውስጥ የውኃውን መንቀሳቀስ እየጠበቁ በሽተኞችና ዕውሮች አንካሶችም ሰውነታቸውም የሰለለ ብዙ ሕዝብ ይተኙ ነበር።

verses.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ የጌታ መልአክ ወደ መጠመቂያይቱ ወርዶ ውኃውን ያናውጥ ነበርና፤ እንግዲህ ከውኃው መናወጥ በኋላ በመጀመሪያ የገባ ከማናቸው ካለበት ደዌ ጤናማ ይሆን ነበር።

verses.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
verses.am: በዚያም ከሠላሳ ስምንት ዓመት ጀምሮ የታመመ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤

verses.en: When Yahushua saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ይህን ሰው ተኝቶ ባየ ጊዜ፥ እስከ አሁን ብዙ ዘመን እንዲሁ እንደ ነበረ አውቆ። ልትድን ትወዳለህን? አለው።

verses.en: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
verses.am: ድውዩም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ውኃው በተናወጠ ጊዜ በመጠመቂያይቱ ውስጥ የሚያኖረኝ ሰው የለኝም ነገር ግን እኔ ስመጣ ሳለሁ ሌላው ቀድሞኝ ይወርዳል ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Yahushua saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ። ተነሣና አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለው።

verses.en: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
verses.am: ወዲያውም ሰውዬው ዳነ አልጋውንም ተሸክሞ ሄደ።

verses.en: The Yehudim therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
verses.am: ያም ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ። ስለዚህ አይሁድ የተፈወሰውን ሰው። ሰንበት ነው አልጋህንም ልትሸከም አልተፈቀደልህም አሉት።

verses.en: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። ያዳነኝ ያ ሰው። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ አለኝ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
verses.am: እነርሱም። አልጋህን ተሸክመህ ሂድ ያለህ ሰው ማን ነው? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Yahushua had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን በዚያ ስፍራ ሕዝብ ሰለ ነበሩ ኢየሱስ ፈቀቅ ብሎ ነበርና የተፈወሰው ሰው ማን እንደ ሆነ አላወቀም።

verses.en: Afterward Yahushua findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ አገኘውና። እነሆ፥ ድነሃል፤ ከዚህ የሚብስ እንዳይደርስብህ ወደ ፊት ኃጢአት አትሥራ አለው።

verses.en: The man departed, and told the Yehudim that it was Yahushua, which had made him whole.
verses.am: ሰውዬው ሄዶ ያዳነው ኢየሱስ እንደ ሆነ ለአይሁድ ነገረ።

verses.en: And therefore did the Yehudim persecute Yahushua, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
verses.am: ስለዚህም በሰንበት ይህን ስላደረገ አይሁድ ኢየሱስን ያሳድዱት ነበር ሊገድሉትም ይፈልጉ ነበር።

verses.en: But Yahushua answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን። አባቴ እስከ ዛሬ ይሠራል እኔም ደግሞ እሠራለሁ ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore the Yehudim sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that YAHUAH was his Father, making himself equal with YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ሰንበትን ስለ ሻረ ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ደግሞ ራሱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አስተካክሎ። እግዚአብሔር አባቴ ነው ስላለ፥ ስለዚህ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት አብዝተው ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.en: Then answered Yahushua and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብ ሲያደርግ ያየውን ነው እንጂ ወልድ ከራሱ ሊያደርግ ምንም አይችልም፤ ያ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ ወልድ ደግሞ ይህን እንዲሁ ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
verses.am: አብ ወልድን ይወዳልና፥ የሚያደርገውንም ሁሉ ያሳየዋል፤ እናንተም ትደነቁ ዘንድ ከዚህ የሚበልጥ ሥራ ያሳየዋል።

verses.en: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
verses.am: አብ ሙታንን እንደሚያነሣ ሕይወትም እንደሚሰጣቸው፥ እንዲሁ ወልድ ደግሞ ለሚወዳቸው ሕይወትን ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.en: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።

verses.en: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚሰማ የላከኝንም የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ ከሞትም ወደ ሕይወት ተሻገረ እንጂ ወደ ፍርድ አይመጣም።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ሙታን የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ድምፅ የሚሰሙበት ሰዓት ይመጣል እርሱም አሁን ነው፤ የሚሰሙትም በሕይወት ይኖራሉ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of YAHUAH: and they that hear shall live.
verses.am: አብ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዳለው እንዲሁ ደግሞ ለወልድ በራሱ ሕይወት እንዲኖረው ሰጥቶታልና።

verses.en: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
verses.am: የሰው ልጅም ስለ ሆነ ይፈርድ ዘንድ ሥልጣን ሰጠው።

verses.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።

verses.en: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
verses.am: እኔ ከራሴ አንዳች ላደርግ አይቻለኝም፤ እንደ ሰማሁ እፈርዳለሁ ፍርዴም ቅን ነው፥ የላከኝን ፈቃድ እንጂ ፈቃዴን አልሻምና።

verses.en: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
verses.am: እኔ ስለ እኔ ስለ ራሴ ብመሰክር ምስክሬ እውነት አይደለም፤

verses.en: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
verses.am: ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክር ሌላ ነው፥ እርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክረው ምስክር እውነት እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁ።

verses.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
verses.am: እናንተ ወደ ዮሐንስ ልካችኋል እርሱም ለእውነት መስክሮአል።

verses.en: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከሰው ምስክር አልቀበልም፥ እናንተ እንድትድኑ ይህን እላለሁ እንጂ።

verses.en: Ye sent unto Yohanan, and he bare witness unto the truth.
verses.am: እርሱ የሚነድና የሚያበራ መብራት ነበረ፥ እናንተም ጥቂት ዘመን በብርሃኑ ደስ ሊላችሁ ወደዳችሁ።

verses.en: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከዮሐንስ ምስክር የሚበልጥ ምስክር አለኝ፤ አብ ልፈጽመው የሰጠኝ ሥራ፥ ይህ የማደርገው ሥራ፥ አብ እንደ ላከኝ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብም እርሱ ስለ እኔ መስክሮአል። ድምፁን ከቶ አልሰማችሁም፥ መልኩንም አላያችሁም፤

verses.en: But I have greater witness than that of Yohanan: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
verses.am: እርሱም የላከውን እናንተ አታምኑምና በእናንተ ዘንድ የሚኖር ቃሉ የላችሁም።

verses.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
verses.am: እናንተ በመጻሕፍት የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳላችሁ ይመስላችኋልና እነርሱን ትመረምራላችሁ፤ እነርሱም ስለ እኔ የሚመሰክሩ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕይወት እንዲሆንላችሁ ወደ እኔ ልትመጡ አትወዱም።

verses.en: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ስም መጥቻለሁ አልተቀበላችሁኝምም፤ ሌላው በራሱ ስም ቢመጣ እርሱን ትቀበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: I receive not honour from men.
verses.am: እናንተ እርስ በርሳችሁ ክብር የምትቀባበሉ ከአንዱም ከእግዚአብሔር ያለውን ክብር የማትፈልጉ፥ እንዴት ልታምኑ ትችላላችሁ?

verses.en: But I know you, that ye have not the love of YAHUAH in you.
verses.am: እኔ በአብ ዘንድ የምከሳችሁ አይምሰላችሁ፤ የሚከሳችሁ አለ፤ እርሱም ተስፋ የምታደርጉት ሙሴ ነው።

verses.en: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
verses.am: ሙሴንስ ብታምኑት እኔን ባመናችሁ ነበር፤ እርሱ ስለ እኔ ጽፎአልና።

verses.en: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from YAHUAH only?
verses.am: መጻሕፍትን ካላመናችሁ ግን ቃሌን እንዴት ታምናላችሁ?

verses.en: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Mosheh, in whom ye trust.
For had ye believed Mosheh, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
After these things Yahushua went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
verses.am: ከዚህ በኋላ ኢየሱስ ወደ ገሊላ ባሕር ማዶ ተሻገረ፤ እርሱም የጥብርያዶስ ባሕር ነው።

verses.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
verses.am: በበሽተኞችም ያደረገውን ምልክቶች ስላዩ ብዙ ሕዝብ ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And Yahushua went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ወደ ተራራ ወጣና በዚያ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And the passover, a feast of the Yehudim, was nigh.
verses.am: የአይሁድ በዓልም ፋሲካ ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: When Yahushua then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን አንሥቶ ብዙ ሕዝብ ወደ እርሱ ሲመጣ አየና ፊልጶስን። እነዚህ እንዲበሉ እንጀራ ከወዴት እንገዛለን? አለው።

verses.en: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.am: ራሱ ሊያደርግ ያለውን ያውቅ ነበርና ሊፈትነው ይህን ተናገረ።

verses.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
verses.am: ፊልጶስ። እያንዳንዳቸው ትንሽ ትንሽ እንኳ እንዲቀበሉ የሁለት መቶ ዲናር እንጀራ አይበቃቸውም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Kepha's brother, saith unto him,
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ አንዱ የስምዖን ጴጥሮስ ወንድም እንድርያስ።

verses.en: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
verses.am: አምስት የገብስ እንጀራና ሁለት ዓሣ የያዘ ብላቴና በዚህ አለ፤ ነገር ግን እነዚህን ለሚያህሉ ሰዎች ይህ ምን ይሆናል? አለው።

verses.en: And Yahushua said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ሰዎቹን እንዲቀመጡ አድርጉ አለ። በዚያም ስፍራ ብዙ ሣር ነበረበት። ወንዶችም ተቀመጡ ቍጥራቸውም አምስት ሺህ የሚያህል ነበር።

verses.en: And Yahushua took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንጀራውን ያዘ፥ አመስግኖም ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ ሰጠ፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለተቀመጡት ሰዎች ሰጡአቸው እንዲሁም ከዓሣው በፈለጉት መጠን።

verses.en: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
verses.am: ከጠገቡም በኋላ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን። አንድ ስንኳ እንዳይጠፋ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አከማቹ አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
verses.am: ሰለዚህ አከማቹ፥ ከበሉትም ከአምስቱ የገብስ እንጀራ የተረፈውን ቍርስራሽ አሥራ ሁለት መሶብ ሞሉ።

verses.en: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Yahushua did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
verses.am: ከዚህ የተነሣ ሰዎቹ ኢየሱስ ያደረገውን ምልክት ባዩ ጊዜ። ይህ በእውነት ወደ ዓለም የሚመጣው ነቢይ ነው አሉ።

verses.en: When Yahushua therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
verses.am: በዚህም ምክንያት ኢየሱስ ያነግሡት ዘንድ ሊመጡና ሊነጥቁት እንዳላቸው አውቆ ደግሞ ወደ ተራራ ብቻውን ፈቀቅ አለ።

verses.en: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
verses.am: በመሸም ጊዜ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ወደ ባሕር ወረዱ፥

verses.en: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Yahushua was not come to them.
verses.am: በታንኳም ገብተው በባሕር ማዶ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም ይመጡ ነበር። አሁንም ጨልሞ ነበር፤ ኢየሱስም ገና ወደ እነርሱ አልመጣም ነበር፤

verses.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
verses.am: ብርቱ ነፋስም ስለ ነፈሰ ባሕሩ ተናወጠ።

verses.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Yahushua walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
verses.am: ሀያ አምስት ወይም ሠላሳ ምዕራፍ ከቀዘፉ በኋላም፥ ኢየሱስ በባሕር ላይ እየሄደ ወደ ታንኳይቱ ሲቀርብ አይተው ፈሩ።

verses.en: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
verses.am: እርሱ ግን። እኔ ነኝ፤ አትፍሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በታንኳይቱ ሊቀበሉት ወደዱ፤ ወዲያውም ታንኳይቱ ወደሚሄዱበት ምድር ደረሰች።

verses.en: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Yahushua went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
verses.am: በነገው በባሕር ማዶ ቆመው የነበሩ ሕዝቡ ከአንዲት ጀልባ በቀር በዚያ ሌላ ጀልባ እንዳልነበረች፥ ደቀ መዛሙርቱም ለብቻቸው እንደ ሄዱ እንጂ ኢየሱስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ወደ ታንኳይቱ እንዳልገባ አዩ፤

verses.en: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Master had given thanks:)
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን ሌሎች ጀልባዎች ጌታ የባረከውን እንጀራ ወደ በሉበት ስፍራ አጠገብ ከጥብርያዶስ መጡ።

verses.en: When the people therefore saw that Yahushua was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Yahushua.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ኢየሱስ ወይም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በዚያ እንዳልነበሩ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ ራሳቸው በጀልባዎቹ ገብተው ኢየሱስን እየፈለጉ ወደ ቅፍርናሆም መጡ።

verses.en: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
verses.am: በባሕር ማዶም ሲያገኙት። መምህር ሆይ፥ ወደዚህ መቼ መጣህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መልሶ። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የምትፈልጉኝ እንጀራን ስለ በላችሁና ስለ ጠገባችሁ ነው እንጂ ምልክቶችን ስላያችሁ አይደለም።

verses.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath YAHUAH the Father sealed.
verses.am: ለሚጠፋ መብል አትሥሩ፤ ነገር ግን ለዘላለም ሕይወት ለሚኖር መብል የሰው ልጅ ለሚሰጣችሁ ሥሩ፤ እርሱን እግዚአብሔር አብ አትሞታልና።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of YAHUAH?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። የእግዚአብሔርን ሥራ እንድንሠራ ምን እናድርግ? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto them, This is the work of YAHUAH, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መልሶ። ይህ የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ እርሱ በላከው እንድታምኑ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
verses.am: እንግዲህ። እንኪያ አይተን እንድናምንህ አንተ ምን ምልክት ታደርጋለህ? ምንስ ትሠራለህ?

verses.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
verses.am: ይበሉ ዘንድ ከሰማይ እንጀራ ሰጣቸው ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ አባቶቻችን በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ አሉት።

verses.en: Then Yahushua said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Mosheh gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እውነተኛ እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚሰጣችሁ አባቴ ነው እንጂ ከሰማይ እንጀራ የሰጣችሁ ሙሴ አይደለም፤

verses.en: For the bread of YAHUAH is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር እንጀራ ከሰማይ የሚወርድ ለዓለምም ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ ነውና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Master, evermore give us this bread.
verses.am: ስለዚህ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ይህን እንጀራ ዘወትር ስጠን አሉት።

verses.en: And Yahushua said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ወደ እኔ የሚመጣ ከቶ አይራብም በእኔ የሚያምንም ሁልጊዜ ከቶ አይጠማም።

verses.en: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አይታችሁኝ እንዳላመናችሁ አልኋችሁ።

verses.en: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
verses.am: አብ የሚሰጠኝ ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል፥ ወደ እኔም የሚመጣውን ከቶ ወደ ውጭ አላወጣውም፤

verses.en: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
verses.am: ፈቃዴን ለማድረግ አይደለም እንጂ የላከኝን ፈቃድ ለማድረግ ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁና።

verses.en: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
verses.am: ከሰጠኝም ሁሉ አንድን ስንኳ እንዳላጠፋ በመጨረሻው ቀን እንዳስነሣው እንጂ የላከኝ የአብ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.am: ልጅንም አይቶ በእርሱ የሚያምን ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወትን እንዲያገኝ የአባቴ ፈቃድ ይህ ነው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.en: The Yehudim then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ ስላለ ስለ እርሱ አንጐራጐሩና።

verses.en: And they said, Is not this Yahushua, the son of Yoseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
verses.am: አባቱንና እናቱን የምናውቃቸው ይህ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ኢየሱስ አይደለምን? እንግዲህ። ከሰማይ ወርጃለሁ እንዴት ይላል? አሉ።

verses.en: Yahushua therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እርስ በርሳችሁ አታንጐራጕሩ።

verses.en: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብ ከሳበው በቀር ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.en: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of YAHUAH. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
verses.am: ሁሉም ከእግዚአብሔር የተማሩ ይሆናሉ ተብሎ በነቢያት ተጽፎአል፤ እንግዲህ ከአብ የሰማ የተማረም ሁሉ ወደ እኔ ይመጣል።

verses.en: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of YAHUAH, he hath seen the Father.
verses.am: አብን ያየ ማንም የለም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ በቀር፥ እርሱ አብን አይቶአል።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ በእኔ የሚያምን የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው።

verses.en: I am that bread of life.
verses.am: የሕይወት እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
verses.am: አባቶቻችሁ በምድረ በዳ መና በሉ ሞቱም፤

verses.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
verses.am: ሰው ከእርሱ በልቶ እንዳይሞት ከሰማይ አሁን የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
verses.am: ከሰማይ የወረደ ሕያው እንጀራ እኔ ነኝ፤ ሰው ከዚህ እንጀራ ቢበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ እኔም ስለ ዓለም ሕይወት የምሰጠው እንጀራ ሥጋዬ ነው።

verses.en: The Yehudim therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። ይህ ሰው ሥጋውን ልንበላ ይሰጠን ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተከራከሩ።

verses.en: Then Yahushua said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አላቸው። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ የሰውን ልጅ ሥጋ ካልበላችሁ ደሙንም ካልጠጣችሁ በራሳችሁ ሕይወት የላችሁም።

verses.en: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.am: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ የዘላለም ሕይወት አለው፥ እኔም በመጨረሻው ቀን አስነሣዋለሁ።

verses.en: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.am: ሥጋዬ እውነተኛ መብል ደሜም እውነተኛ መጠጥ ነውና።

verses.en: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
verses.am: ሥጋዬን የሚበላ ደሜንም የሚጠጣ በእኔ ይኖራል እኔም በእርሱ እኖራለሁ።

verses.en: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
verses.am: ሕያው አብ እንደ ላከኝ እኔም ከአብ የተነሣ ሕያው እንደምሆን፥ እንዲሁ የሚበላኝ ደግሞ ከእኔ የተነሣ ሕያው ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
verses.am: ከሰማይ የወረደ እንጀራ ይህ ነው፤ አባቶቻችሁ መና በልተው እንደ ሞቱ አይደለም፤ ይህን እንጀራ የሚበላ ለዘላለም ይኖራል

verses.en: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
verses.am: በቅፍርናሆም ሲያስተምር ይህን በምኵራብ አለ።

verses.en: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
verses.am: ከደቀ መዛሙርቱም ብዙዎች በሰሙ ጊዜ። ይህ የሚያስጨንቅ ንግግር ነው፤ ማን ሊሰማው ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: When Yahushua knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ስለዚህ እንዳንጐራጐሩ በልቡ አውቆ አላቸው። ይህ ያሰናክላችኋልን?

verses.en: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
verses.am: እንግዲህ የሰው ልጅ አስቀድሞ ወደ ነበረበት ሲወጣ ብታዩ እንዴት ይሆናል?

verses.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
verses.am: ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ መንፈስ ነው፤ ሥጋ ምንም አይጠቅምም፤ እኔ የነገርኋችሁ ቃል መንፈስ ነው ሕይወትም ነው።

verses.en: But there are some of you that believe not. For Yahushua knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ የማያምኑ አሉ። ኢየሱስ የማያምኑት እነማን እንደ ሆኑ አሳልፎ የሚሰጠውም ማን እንደ ሆነ ከመጀመሪያ ያውቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
verses.am: ደግሞ። ስለዚህ አልኋችሁ፥ ከአብ የተሰጠው ካልሆነ ወደ እኔ ሊመጣ የሚችል የለም አለ።

verses.en: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
verses.am: ከዚህም የተነሣ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ብዙዎች ወደ ኋላ ተመለሱ፤ ወደ ፊትም ከእርሱ ጋር አልሄዱም።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ለአሥራ ሁለቱ። እናንተ ደግሞ ልትሄዱ ትወዳላችሁን? አለ።

verses.en: Then Simon Kepha answered him, Master, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
verses.am: ስምዖን ጴጥሮስ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ ወደ ማን እንሄዳለን? አንተ የዘላለም ሕይወት ቃል አለህ፤

verses.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Messiah, the Son of the living YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኛስ አንተ ክርስቶስ የሕያው የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆንህ አምነናል አውቀናልም ብሎ መለሰለት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እኔ እናንተን አሥራ ሁለታችሁን የመረጥኋችሁ አይደለምን? ከእናንተም አንዱ ዲያብሎስ ነው ብሎ መለሰላቸው።

verses.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
verses.am: ስለ ስምዖንም ልጅ ስለ አስቆሮቱ ይሁዳ ተናገረ፤ ከአሥራ ሁለቱ አንዱ የሆነ እርሱ አሳልፎ ይሰጠው ዘንድ አለውና።

verses.en: After these things Yahushua walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Yehudim sought to kill him.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኢየሱስ አይሁድ ሊገድሉት ይፈልጉ ስለ ነበር በይሁዳ ሊመላለስ አይወድም ነበርና በገሊላ ይመላለስ ነበር።

verses.en: Now the Yehudim' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
verses.am: የአይሁድም የዳስ በዓል ቀርቦ ነበር።

verses.en: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወንድሞቹ። ደቀ መዛሙርትህ ደግሞ የምታደርገውን ሥራ እንዲያዩ ከዚህ ተነሣና ወደ ይሁዳ ሂድ፤

verses.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
verses.am: ራሱ ሊገለጥ እየፈለገ በስውር የሚሠራ የለምና። እነዚህን ብታደርግ ራስህን ለዓለም ግለጥ አሉት።

verses.en: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ ስንኳ አላመኑበትም ነበርና።

verses.en: Then Yahushua said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው። ጊዜዬ ገና አልደረሰም፥ ጊዜያችሁ ግን ዘወትር የተመቸ ነው።

verses.en: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
verses.am: ዓለም እናንተን ሊጠላ አይቻለውም፤ እኔ ግን ሥራው ክፉ መሆኑን እመሰክርበታለሁና እኔን ይጠላኛል።

verses.en: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
verses.am: እናንተ ወደዚህ በዓል ውጡ፤ እኔስ ጊዜዬ ገና ስላልተፈጸመ ወደዚህ በዓል ገና አልወጣም።

verses.en: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
verses.am: ይህንም አላቸውና በገሊላ ቀረ።

verses.en: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
verses.am: ወንድሞቹ ግን ወደ በዓሉ ከወጡ በኋላ በዚያን ጊዜ እርሱ ደግሞ በግልጥ ሳይሆን ተሰውሮ ወጣ።

verses.en: Then the Yehudim sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
verses.am: አይሁድም። እርሱ ወዴት ነው? እያሉ በበዓሉ ይፈልጉት ነበር።

verses.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
verses.am: በሕዝብም መካከል ስለ እርሱ ብዙ ማንጐራጐር ነበረ፤ አንዳንዱም። ደግ ሰው ነው፤ ሌሎች ግን። አይደለም፥ ሕዝቡን ግን ያስታል ይሉ ነበር።

verses.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Yehudim.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ማንም ስለ እርሱ በግልጥ አይናገርም ነበር።

verses.en: Now about the midst of the feast Yahushua went up into the temple, and taught.
verses.am: አሁንም በበዓሉ እኩሌታ ኢየሱስ ወደ መቅደስ ወጥቶ ያስተምር ነበር።

verses.en: And the Yehudim marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
verses.am: አይሁድም። ይህ ሰው ሳይማር መጻሕፍትን እንዴት ያውቃል? ብለው ይደነቁ ነበር።

verses.en: Yahushua answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ መለሰ እንዲህም አላቸው። ትምህርቴስ ከላከኝ ነው እንጂ ከእኔ አይደለም፤

verses.en: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of YAHUAH, or whether I speak of myself.
verses.am: ፈቃዱን ሊያደርግ የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ እርሱ ይህ ትምህርት ከእግዚአብሔር ቢሆን ወይም እኔ ከራሴ የምናገር ብሆን ያውቃል።

verses.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
verses.am: ከራሱ የሚናገር የራሱን ክብር ይፈልጋል፤ የላከውን ክብር የሚፈልግ ግን እርሱ እውነተኛ ነው በእርሱም ዓመፃ የለበትም።

verses.en: Did not Mosheh give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
verses.am: ሙሴ ሕግን አልሰጣችሁምን? ከእናንተ ግን ሕግን የሚያደርግ አንድ ስንኳ የለም። ልትገድሉኝ ስለ ምን ትፈልጋላችሁ?

verses.en: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
verses.am: ሕዝቡ መለሱና። ጋኔን አለብህ፤ ማን ሊገድልህ ይፈልጋል? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። አንድ ሥራ አደረግሁ ሁላችሁም ታደንቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Mosheh therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Mosheh, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሙሴ መገረዝን ሰጣችሁ፤ ከአባቶችም ነው እንጂ ከሙሴ አይደለም፤ በሰንበትም ሰውን ትገርዛላችሁ።

verses.en: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Mosheh should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
verses.am: የሙሴ ሕግ እንዳይሻር ሰው በሰንበት መገረዝን የሚቀበል ከሆነስ ሰውን ሁለንተናውን በሰንበት ጤናማ ስላደረግሁ ትቈጡኛላችሁን?

verses.en: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
verses.am: ቅን ፍርድ ፍረዱ እንጂ በመልክ አትፍረዱ።

verses.en: Then said some of them of Yerushalayim, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች አንዳንዶቹ እንዲህ አሉ። ሊገድሉት የሚፈልጉት ይህ አይደለምን?

verses.en: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Messiah?
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በግልጥ ይናገራል አንዳችም አይሉትም። አለቆቹ ይህ ሰው በእውነት ክርስቶስ እንደ ሆነ በእውነት አወቁን?

verses.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Messiah cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይህን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ አውቀናል፤ ክርስቶስ ሲመጣ ግን ከወዴት እንደ ሆነ ማንም አያውቅም።

verses.en: Then cried Yahushua in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር። እኔንም ታውቁኛላችሁ ከወዴትም እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ እኔም በራሴ አልመጣሁም ነገር ግን እናንተ የማታውቁት የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው፤

verses.en: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከእርሱ ዘንድ ነኝ እርሱም ልኮኛልና አውቀዋለሁ ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሊይዙት ይፈልጉ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ጊዜው ገና ስላልደረሰ ማንም እጁን አልጫነበትም።

verses.en: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Messiah cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
verses.am: ከሕዝቡ ግን ብዙዎች አመኑበትና። ክርስቶስ በመጣ ጊዜ ይህ ካደረጋቸው ምልክቶች ይልቅ ያደርጋልን? አሉ።

verses.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም ሕዝቡ ሰለ እርሱ እንደዚህ ሲያንጐራጕሩ ሰሙ፤ የካህናት አለቆችም ፈሪሳውያም ሊይዙት ሎሌዎችን ላኩ።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። ገና ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእናንተ ጋር እቆያለሁ ወደ ላከኝም እሄዳለሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
verses.am: ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም፤ እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አለ።

verses.en: Then said the Yehudim among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the nations, and teach the nations?
verses.am: እንግዲህ አይሁድ። እኛ እንዳናገኘው ይህ ወዴት ይሄድ ዘንድ አለው? በግሪክ ሰዎች መካከል ተበትነው ወደሚኖሩት ሊሄድና የግሪክን ሰዎች ሊያስተምር አለውን?

verses.en: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
verses.am: እርሱ። ትፈልጉኛላችሁ አታገኙኝምም እኔም ወዳለሁበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም የሚለው ይህ ቃል ምንድር ነው? ብለው እርስ በርሳቸው ተነጋገሩ።

verses.en: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahushua stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
verses.am: ከበዓሉም በታላቁ በኋለኛው ቀን ኢየሱስ ቆሞ። ማንም የተጠማ ቢኖር ወደ እኔ ይምጣና ይጠጣ።

verses.en: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
verses.am: በእኔ የሚያምን መጽሐፍ እንዳለ፥ የሕይወት ውኃ ወንዝ ከሆዱ ይፈልቃል ብሎ ጮኸ።

verses.en: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Set-apart Spirit was not yet given; because that Yahushua was not yet glorified.)
verses.am: ይህን ግን በእርሱ የሚያምኑ ሊቀበሉት ስላላቸው ስለ መንፈስ ተናገረ፤ ኢየሱስ ገና ስላልከበረ መንፈስ ገና አልወረደም ነበርና።

verses.en: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎች ይህን ቃል ሲሰሙ። ይህ በእውነት ነቢዩ ነው አሉ፤

verses.en: Others said, This is the Messiah. But some said, Shall Messiah come out of Galilee?
verses.am: ሌሎች። ይህ ክርስቶስ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች ግን። ክርስቶስ በእውኑ ከገሊላ ይመጣልን?

verses.en: Hath not the scripture said, That Messiah cometh of the seed of Dawid, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where Dawid was?
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ከዳዊት ዘር ዳዊትም ከነበረባት መንደር ከቤተ ልሔም እንዲመጣ መጽሐፍ አላለምን? አሉ።

verses.en: So there was a division among the people because of him.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ከእርሱ የተነሣ በሕዝቡ መካከል መለያየት ሆነ፤

verses.en: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳንዶቹ ሊይዙት ወደዱ ነገር ግን እጁን ማንም አልጫነበትም።

verses.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
verses.am: ሎሌዎቹም ወደ ካህናት አለቆችና ወደ ፈሪሳውያን መጡ፤ እነዚያም። ያላመጣችሁት ስለ ምን ነው? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
verses.am: ሎሌዎቹ። እንደዚህ ሰው ማንም እንዲሁ ከቶ አልተናገረም ብለው መለሱ።

verses.en: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ፈሪሳውያን። እናንተ ደግሞ ሳታችሁን?

verses.en: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
verses.am: ከአለቆች ወይስ ከፈሪሳውያን በእርሱ ያመነ አለን?

verses.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕግን የማያውቀው ይህ ሕዝብ ርጉም ነው ብለው መለሱላቸው።

verses.en: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Yahushua by night, being one of them,)
verses.am: ከእነርሱ አንዱ በሌሊት ቀድሞ ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ የነበረ ኒቆዲሞስ።

verses.en: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
verses.am: ሕጋችን አስቀድሞ ከእርሱ ሳይሰማ ምንስ እንዳደረገ ሳያውቅ በሰው ይፈርዳልን? አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
verses.am: እነርሱም መለሱና። አንተም ደግሞ ከገሊላ ነህን? ነቢይ ከገሊላ እንዳይነሣ መርምርና እይ አሉት።

verses.en: And every man went unto his own house.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።

verses.en: Yahushua went unto the mount of Olives.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ግን ወደ ደብረ ዘይት ሄደ።

verses.en: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
verses.am: ማለዳም ደግሞ ወደ መቅደስ ደረሰ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ መጡ። ተቀምጦም ያስተምራቸው ነበር።

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
verses.am: ጻፎችና ፈሪሳውያንም በምንዝር የተያዘችን ሴት ወደ እርሱ አመጡ በመካከልም እርሱዋን አቁመው።

verses.en: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
verses.am: መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህች ሴት ስታመነዝር ተገኝታ ተያዘች።

verses.en: Now Mosheh in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደነዚህ ያሉት እንዲወገሩ በሕግ አዘዘን፤ አንተስ ስለ እርስዋ ምን ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Yahushua stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
verses.am: የሚከሱበትንም እንዲያገኙ ሊፈትኑት ይህን አሉ። ኢየሱስ ግን ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ፤

verses.en: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
verses.am: መላልሰው በጠየቁት ጊዜ ግን ቀና ብሎ። ከእናንተ ኃጢአት የሌለበት አስቀድሞ በድንጋይ ይውገራት አላቸው።

verses.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
verses.am: ደግሞም ጐንበስ ብሎ በጣቱ በምድር ላይ ጻፈ።

verses.en: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Yahushua was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
verses.am: እነርሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ ሕሊናቸው ወቀሳቸውና ከሽማግሌዎች ጀምረው እስከ ኋለኞች አንድ አንድ እያሉ ወጡ፤ ኢየሱስም ብቻውን ቀረ ሴቲቱም በመካከል ቆማ ነበረች።

verses.en: When Yahushua had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ቀና ብሎ ከሴቲቱ በቀር ማንንም ባላየ ጊዜ። አንቺ ሴት፥ እነዚያ ከሳሾችሽ ወዴት አሉ? የፈረደብሽ የለምን? አላት።

verses.en: She said, No man, Master. And Yahushua said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንድ ስንኳ አለች። ኢየሱስም። እኔም አልፈርድብሽም፤ ሂጂ ከአሁንም ጀምሮ ደግመሽ ኃጢአት አትሥሪ አላት።

verses.en: Then spake Yahushua again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
verses.am: ደግሞም ኢየሱስ። እኔ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ፤ የሚከተለኝ የሕይወት ብርሃን ይሆንለታል እንጂ በጨለማ አይመላለስም ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
verses.am: ፈሪሳውያንም። አንተ ስለ ራስህ ትመሰክራለህ፤ ምስክርነትህ እውነት አይደለም አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ አላቸውም። እኔ ስለ ራሴ ምንም እንኳ ብመሰክር ከወዴት እንደመጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አውቃለሁና ምስክርነቴ እውነት ነው፤ እናንተ ግን ከወዴት እንደ መጣሁ ወዴትም እንድሄድ አታውቁም።

verses.en: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
verses.am: እናንተ ሥጋዊ ፍርድን ትፈርዳላችሁ፤ እኔ በአንድ ሰው ስንኳ አልፈርድም።

verses.en: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
verses.am: የላከኝ አብ ከእኔ ጋር ነው እንጂ ብቻዬን አይደለሁምና እኔ ብፈርድ ፍርዴ እውነት ነው።

verses.en: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
verses.am: የሁለት ሰዎችም ምስክርነት እውነት እንደ ሆነ በሕጋችሁ ተጽፎአል።

verses.en: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
verses.am: ስለ ራሴ የምመሰክር እኔ ነኝ፥ የላከኝም አብ ስለ እኔ ይመሰክራል።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Yahushua answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። አባትህ ወዴት ነው? አሉት። ኢየሱስ መልሶ። እኔንም ወይም አባቴንም አታውቁም፤ እኔንስ ብታውቁኝ አባቴን ደግሞ ባወቃችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.en: These words spake Yahushua in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ በመቅደስ ሲያስተምር በግምጃ ቤት አጠገብ ይህን ነገር ተናገረ፤ ጊዜው ገና አልደረሰምና ማንም አልያዘውም።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ደግሞ። እኔ እሄዳለሁ ትፈልጉኛላችሁም በኃጢአታችሁም ትሞታላችሁ እኔ ወደምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said the Yehudim, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
verses.am: አይሁድም። እኔ ወደ ምሄድበት እናንተ ልትመጡ አትችሉም ማለቱ ራሱን ይገድላልን? እንጃ አሉ።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
verses.am: እናንተ ከታች ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከላይ ነኝ፤ እናንተ ከዚህ ዓለም ናችሁ፥ እኔ ከዚህ ዓለም አይደለሁም።

verses.en: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁ አልኋችሁ፤ እኔ እንደሆንሁ ባታምኑ በኃጢአታችሁ ትሞታላችሁና አላቸው።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Yahushua saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
verses.am: እንግዲህ። አንተ ማን ነህ? አሉት። ኢየሱስም። ከመጀመሪያ ለእናንተ የተናገርሁት ነኝ።

verses.en: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ የምናገረው የምፈርደውም ብዙ ነገር አለኝ፤ ዳሩ ግን የላከኝ እውነተኛ ነው እኔም ከእርሱ የሰማሁትን ይህን ለዓለም እናገራለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
verses.am: ስለ አብ እንደ ነገራቸው አላስተዋሉም።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ኢየሱስ። የሰውን ልጅ ከፍ ከፍ ባደረጋችሁት ጊዜ እኔ እሆን ዘንድ አባቴም እንዳስተማረኝ እነዚህን እናገር ዘንድ እንጂ ከራሴ አንዳች እንዳላደርግ በዚያን ጊዜ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
verses.am: የላከኝም ከእኔ ጋር ነው፤ እኔ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ዘወትር አደርጋለሁና አብ ብቻዬን አይተወኝም አላቸው።

verses.en: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
verses.am: ይህን ሲናገር ብዙዎች በእርሱ አመኑ።

verses.en: Then said Yahushua to those Yehudim which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ያመኑትን አይሁድ። እናንተ በቃሌ ብትኖሩ በእውነት ደቀ መዛሙርቴ ናችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
verses.am: እውነትንም ታውቃላችሁ እውነትም አርነት ያወጣችኋል አላቸው።

verses.en: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
verses.am: እነርሱም መልሰው። የአብርሃም ዘር ነን ለአንድም ስንኳ ከቶ ባሪያዎች አልሆንም፤ አንተ። አርነት ትወጣላችሁ እንዴት ትላለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ኃጢአት የሚያደርግ ሁሉ የኃጢአት ባርያ ነው።

verses.en: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
verses.am: ባርያም ለዘላለም በቤት አይኖርም፤ ልጁ ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ልጁ አርነት ቢያወጣችሁ በእውነት አርነት ትወጣላችሁ።

verses.en: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
verses.am: የአብርሃም ዘር መሆናችሁንስ አውቃለሁ ነገር ግን ቃሌ በእናንተ አይኖርምና ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ።

verses.en: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
verses.am: እኔ በአባቴ ዘንድ ያየሁትን እናገራለሁ፤ እናንተም ደግሞ በአባታችሁ ዘንድ ያያችሁትን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Yahushua saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
verses.am: መልሰውም። አባታችንስ አብርሃም ነው አሉት። ኢየሱስም። የአብሃም ልጆች ብትሆኑ የአብርሃምን ሥራ ባደረጋችሁ ነበር።

verses.en: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of YAHUAH: this did not Abraham.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሁን ከእግዚእብሔር የሰማሁትን እውነት የነገርኋችሁን ሰው ልትገድሉኝ ትፈልጋላችሁ፤ አብርሃም እንዲህ አላደረገም።

verses.en: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even YAHUAH.
verses.am: እናንተ የአባታችሁን ሥራ ታደርጋላችሁ አላቸው። እኛስ ከዝሙት አልተወለድንም አንድ አባት አለን እርሱም እግዚአብሔር ነው አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua said unto them, If YAHUAH were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from YAHUAH; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም አላቸው። እግዚአብሔርስ አባታችሁ ከሆነ በወደዳችሁኝ ነበር፤ እኔ ከእግዚአብሔር ወጥቼ መጥቻለሁና፤ እርሱ ላከኝ እንጂ ከራሴ አልመጣሁምና።

verses.en: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
verses.am: ንግግሬን የማታስተውሉ ስለ ምንድር ነው? ቃሌን ልትሰሙ ስለማትችሉ ነው።

verses.en: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
verses.am: እናንተ ከአባታችሁ ከዲያብሎስ ናችሁ የአባታችሁንም ምኞት ልታደርጉ ትወዳላችሁ። እርሱ ከመጀመሪያ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነበረ፤ እውነትም በእርሱ ስለ ሌለ በእውነት አልቆመም። ሐሰትን ሲናገር ከራሱ ይናገራል፥ ሐሰተኛ የሐሰትም አባት ነውና።

verses.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
verses.am: እኔ ግን እውነትን የምናገር ስለ ሆንሁ አታምኑኝም።

verses.en: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
verses.am: ከእናንተ ስለ ኃጢአት የሚወቅሰኝ ማን ነው? እውነት የምናገር ከሆንሁ እናንተ ስለ ምን አታምኑኝም?

verses.en: He that is of YAHUAH heareth YAHUAH's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የሆነ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ይሰማል፤ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደላችሁምና ስለዚህ አትሰሙም።

verses.en: Then answered the Yehudim, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
verses.am: አይሁድ መልሰው። ሳምራዊ እንደ ሆንህ ጋኔንም እንዳለብህ በማለታችን እኛ መልካም እንል የለምን? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ፥ እንዲህ ሲል። እኔስ ጋኔን የለብኝም ነገር ግን አባቴን አከብራለሁ እናንተም ታዋርዱኛላችሁ።

verses.en: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
verses.am: እኔ ግን የራሴን ክብር አልፈልግም፤ የሚፈልግ የሚፈርድም አለ።

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
verses.am: እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አያይም።

verses.en: Then said the Yehudim unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
verses.am: አይሁድ። ጋኔን እንዳለብህ አሁን አወቅን። አብርሃም ስንኳ ሞተ ነቢያትም፤ አንተም። ቃሌን የሚጠብቅ ቢኖር ለዘላለም ሞትን አይቀምስም ትላለህ።

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
verses.am: በእውኑ አንተ ከሞተው ከአባታችን ከአብርሃም ትበልጣለህን? ነቢያትም ሞቱ፤ ራስህን ማንን ታደርጋለህ? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your YAHUAH:
verses.am: ኢየሱስም መለሰ አለም። እኔ ራሴን ባከብር ክብሬ ከንቱ ነው፤ የሚያከብረኝ እናንተ አምላካችን የምትሉት አባቴ ነው፤

verses.en: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
verses.am: አላወቃችሁትምም፥ እኔ ግን አውቀዋለሁ። አላውቀውም ብል እንደ እናንተ ሐሰተኛ በሆንሁ፤ ዳሩ ግን አውቀዋለሁ ቃሉንም እጠብቃለሁ።

verses.en: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
verses.am: አባታችሁ አብርሃም ቀኔን ያይ ዘንድ ሐሤት አደረገ፥ አየም ደስም አለው።

verses.en: Then said the Yehudim unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
verses.am: አይሁድም። ገና አምሳ ዓመት ያልሆነህ አብርሃምን አይተሃልን? አሉት።

verses.en: Yahushua said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም። እውነት እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ አብርሃም ሳይወለድ እኔ አለሁ አላቸው።

verses.en: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Yahushua hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ሊወግሩት ድንጋይ አነሡ፤ ኢየሱስ ግን ተሰወራቸው ከመቅደስም ወጥቶ በመካከላቸው አልፎ ሄደ።

verses.en: And as Yahushua passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
verses.am: ሲያልፍም ከመወለዱ ጀምሮ ዕውር የሆነውን ሰው አየ።

verses.en: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
verses.am: ደቀ መዛሙርቱም። መምህር ሆይ፥ ይህ ሰው ዕውር ሆኖ እንዲወለድ ኃጢአት የሠራ ማን ነው? እርሱ ወይስ ወላጆቹ? ብለው ጠየቁት።

verses.en: Yahushua answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of YAHUAH should be made manifest in him.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ። የእግዚአብሔር ሥራ በእርሱ እንዲገለጥ ነው እንጂ እርሱ ወይም ወላጆቹ ኃጢአት አልሠሩም።

verses.en: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
verses.am: ቀን ሳለ የላከኝን ሥራ ላደርግ ይገባኛል፤ ማንም ሊሠራ የማይችልባት ሌሊት ትመጣለች።

verses.en: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
verses.am: በዓለም ሳለሁ የዓለም ብርሃን ነኝ።

verses.en: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
verses.am: ይህን ብሎ ወደ መሬት እንትፍ አለ በምራቁም ጭቃ አድርጎ በጭቃው የዕውሩን ዓይኖች ቀባና።

verses.en: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
verses.am: ሂድና በሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ታጠብ አለው፤ ትርጓሜው የተላከ ነው። ስለዚህ ሄዶ ታጠበ እያየም መጣ።

verses.en: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
verses.am: ጐረቤቶቹም ቀድሞም ሲለምን አይተውት የነበሩ። ይህ ተቀምጦ ይለምን የነበረ አይደለምን? አሉ።

verses.en: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
verses.am: ሌሎች። እርሱ ነው አሉ፤ ሌሎች። አይደለም እርሱን ይመስላል እንጂ አሉ፤ እርሱ። እኔ ነኝ አለ።

verses.en: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
verses.am: ታድያ። ዓይኖችህ እንዴት ተከፈቱ? አሉት።

verses.en: He answered and said, A man that is called Yahushua made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
verses.am: እርሱ መልሶ። ኢየሱስ የሚባለው ሰው ጭቃ አድርጎ አይኖቼን ቀባና። ወደ ሰሊሆም መጠመቂያ ሄደህ ታጠብ አለኝ፤ ሄጄ ታጥቤም አየሁ አለ።

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
verses.am: ያ ሰው ወዴት ነው? አሉት። አላውቅም አለ።

verses.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
verses.am: በፊት ዕውር የነበረውን ሰው ወደ ፈሪሳውያን ወሰዱት።

verses.en: And it was the sabbath day when Yahushua made the clay, and opened his eyes.
verses.am: ኢየሱስም ጭቃ አድርጎ ዓይኖቹን የከፈተበት ቀን ሰንበት ነበረ።

verses.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ፈሪሳውያን ደግሞ እንዴት እንዳየ እንደ ገና ጠየቁት። እርሱም። ጭቃ በዓይኖቼ አኖረ ታጠብሁም አያለሁም አላቸው።

verses.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of YAHUAH, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
verses.am: ከፈሪሳውያንም አንዳንዶቹ። ይህ ሰው ሰንበትን አያከብርምና ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም አሉ። ሌሎች ግን። ኃጢአትኛ ሰው እንደነዚህ ያሉ ምልክቶች ሊያደርግ እንዴት ይችላል? አሉ።

verses.en: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም መለያየት ሆነ። ከዚህም የተነሣ ዕውሩን። አንተ ዓይኖችህን ስለ ከፈተ ስለ እርሱ ምን ትላለህ? ደግሞ አሉት። እርሱም። ነቢይ ነው አለ።

verses.en: But the Yehudim did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
verses.am: አይሁድ የዚያን ያየውን ወላጆች እስኪጠሩ ድረስ ዕውር እንደ ነበረ እንዳየም ስለ እርሱ አላመኑም፥

verses.en: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
verses.am: እነርሱንም። እናንተ ዕውር ሆኖ ተወለደ የምትሉት ልጃችሁ ይህ ነውን? ታድያ አሁን እንዴት ያያል? ብለው ጠየቁአቸው።

verses.en: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
verses.am: ወላጆቹም መልሰው። ይህ ልጃችን እንደ ሆነ ዕውርም ሆኖ እንደ ተወለደ አናውቃለን፤

verses.en: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን አሁን እንዴት እንዳየ አናውቅም፥ ወይም ዓይኖቹን ማን እንደ ከፈተ እኛ አናውቅም፤ ጠይቁት እርሱ ሙሉ ሰው ነው፤ እርሱ ስለ ራሱ ይናገራል አሉ።

verses.en: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Yehudim: for the Yehudim had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Messiah, he should be put out of the synagogue.
verses.am: ወላጆቹ አይሁድን ስለ ፈሩ ይህን አሉ፤ እርሱ ክርስቶስ ነው ብሎ የሚመሰክር ቢኖር ከምኵራብ እንዲያወጡት አይሁድ ከዚህ በፊት ተስማምተው ነበርና።

verses.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወላጆቹ። ሙሉ ሰው ነው፥ ጠይቁት አሉ።

verses.en: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give YAHUAH the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
